findings.finding: Dräger, Getinge's closest listed peer in ventilation and anaesthesia, pre-released Q3 2026 by ad-hoc on 14 October: medical division net sales -1.4% and medical order intake -3.0%, both net of currency. This is a negative read-through for the capital-equipment part of Getinge's Acute Care Therapies in a quarter whose comparative was itself ventilator-driven.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Getinge has moved hard on organic growth and orders. 2026-01-27 (Q4, lower orders and sales): -5.8%. 2025-10-21 (Q3 2025, +9.5% organic on ventilators): +2.7%. 2026-04-21 (Q1, +0.8% organic with ventilators down): -1.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had read this across, Getinge would have fallen after 14 October. Instead it closed 256.8 on 10-14, 259.2 on 10-15 and 258.7 on 10-20. Consensus organic growth of 2.2% was set before or alongside the Dräger print (oldest estimate 09-23) and is not visibly marked down. It is partly priced anyway because 2.2% already assumes a weak quarter against +9.5%. It is a peer proxy, not a Getinge number. Net of the rest of the company: ECLS consumables, stents, EVH, Surgical Workflows (~33% of sales) and Sterile Transfer can offset it, so it is sized well below the money at stake.
findings.independence: Getinge's own Q1 2026 report showed ventilators declining after the 2025 consolidation-driven surge, which is consistent with a soft capital-ventilator market (https://mfn.se/all/a/getinge/getinge-interim-report-january-march-2026-organic-growth-strong-cash-flow-and-regulatory-milestone-9e0ea7aa). Weak support, and it is about Q1.

findings.finding: Getinge's Q2 2026 report puts margin ex-refund at 13.6% (EBITA 1,478 less the 336 refund, on 8,381 sales) against 12.0% a year earlier, with ongoing tariff cost down (SEK 92M vs 110M). USD/SEK averaged 9.65 in Q3 2026 against 9.51 in Q3 2025, after a Q2 currency headwind of SEK -73M. Together these point to Q3 adj EBITA a few percent above the 14.05% / 1,185 consensus, which embeds only +0.95pp year on year against +1.6pp in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-17: EBITA beat Infront consensus (1,478 vs 1,379, refund included), stock +10.1%. 2026-01-27: margin and FX/tariff headwinds, -5.8%. Margin beats have been bought here.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus median (https://placera.se/externa-analyser/getinge-getinge-consensus-estimates-q3-2026-20261016) implies a smaller year-on-year margin step than Q2 delivered underlying. If analysts had carried the Q2 trend and the turn in FX, the median would sit nearer 14.5-14.7%. Caveat that reaches the number: Q1 2026's margin was down about 1pp year on year, so H1 ex-refund improved only about 0.4pp, and Q3 volume growth (2.2%) gives less operating leverage than Q2's 4.6%. The trend is mixed, so this is an inference sized small.
findings.independence: FX series from Yahoo USDSEK=X / EURSEK=X daily closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/USDSEK=X?range=2y&interval=1d): Q3-26 average 9.652 vs Q3-25 9.511; EURSEK 11.104 vs 11.116. The Q2 report's EBITA bridge is a different document but the same company.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the +10.1% Q2 day the stock kept rising. No measured instance of this name selling an in-line print from a target-price ceiling.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it agrees with the run-up lean (priced_lean_pct -0.27) and the 60-day run-up of +9.99%, so it is sized small. It is filed because a stock at the mean target typically needs a guide change rather than an in-line quarter to extend.

language_note: Finwire via Placera, in Swedish, carried this name's observed report-day reaction table (Q2-26 +10.1, Q1-26 -1.3, Q4-25 -5.8, Q3-25 +2.7, Q2-25 +6.0, Q1-25 -5.5, Q4-24 +11.1, Q3-24 -5.0; source https://www.placera.se/telegram/getinge-getinge-vantas-redovisa-1-185-miljoner-i-justerat-ebita-resultat-modular-20261016, original 'Kursutveckling vid senaste rapporterna'). It shows the baseline's cadence-estimated 2.34% median understates this name's event scale by more than half, and it is what set abs_move_pct.
Placera's Swedish options article (2026-10-19) confirmed Getinge has no weekly options, so no implied move exists even locally.

lessons_applied: 'Size the move on what is new; let reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': the quarter is entirely new and a guide narrowing is possible, so abs_move_pct went from 5.8 (pinned to the name's own median) to 6.5.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not agree with': the at-target/run-up finding agrees with the lean, so it was cut from -0.4 to -0.2.
'Net of the rest of the company' and 'a narrow proxy is a hypothesis': the Dräger read-through touches only the capital-equipment part of Acute Care, so it was cut from -0.8 to -0.6.

'Your own caveat has to reach the number': Q1's year-on-year margin decline argues against the margin finding, so it was cut from +0.8 to +0.6, and p_up moved from 47 to 48 because the two proxies now offset more evenly.
